character.locked_description: Maya is a 9-year-old South Asian girl with brown skin and curly black hair tied high in a bouncy ponytail. She wears a #2A9D8F teal windbreaker over a gray t-shirt, dark jeans, and sneakers. Fingerless leather gloves cover her hands, and a small adjustable wrench hangs from a lanyard around her neck. She sits upright in a lightweight manual wheelchair featuring a silver aluminum frame, #F4A261 bright orange spoke guards, and a compact toolkit strapped securely under the canvas seat. Her posture is alert and forward-leaning, resting her gloved hands lightly on the rubber-coated handrims of her wheels.
